assays.endpoint: Source-reported second-order initial-rate coefficient; saturation not observed, separate kcat and KM not established
assays.readout: Product absorbance at350nm; initial-rate linear fit v0=(kcat/KM)[E]0[S]0
assays.pH_source: TableI title and Methods, not Figure5 caption
assays.temperature_status: not stated in acquired kinetic protocol
assays.replicates: Methods states each absorbance measurement was done in triplicate; independent protein-preparation count not specified
assays.uncertainty: TableI prints plus/minus errors but does not define SD/SE/CI; triplicate measurements do not resolve the statistic
assays.qualification_scope: Within-TableI source-defined endpoint comparisons only. The conflicting Figure5 conditions remain unresolved and its plotted points are not refitted or pooled.

reaction.stereochemistry: Experimental methodol preparation not assigned R/S rates or enantiopurity in acquired main; p568 R/S structures belong to docking only.
reaction.scope: Source-depicted reaction identity, not a new canonical balanced atom-mapped reaction or full mechanistic trajectory.

nucleophile_controls.question: Does residual methodol activity uniquely establish a lysine-covalent mechanism?

construct_lineage.source_scope: Authors report replacing the four lysines and only histidine in the C-terminal domain.
Sulfo-NHS-acetate treatment and source-reported MALDI-TOF confirmation; raw spectrum/stoichiometry not inspected.

nucleophile_controls.supported_result: Source-reported above-background methodol activity persists after the listed C-terminal Lys/His substitutions and after additional N-terminal acetylation. L105K has a larger TableI endpoint than its full-length CaM reference. These outcomes alone do not identify an exact chemical pathway.
nucleophile_controls.analyst_inference: Residual methodol cleavage in this control series is not unique evidence for a lysine-covalent route. The controls challenge those named amine explanations, but do not establish absence of all possible nucleophiles or prove hydrophobic association as the sole cause.
nucleophile_controls.author_interpretation: Authors attribute the residual scaffold activity to hydrophobic association, and the introduced-Lys enhancement to its designed nucleophilicity/pocket context. This remains source interpretation, not an isolated causal measurement.

preparation_evidence.tag_processing: Main Methods describes N-terminal His6 tag, TEV cleavage and removal of tag/protease by Ni-NTA chromatography.
preparation_evidence.acetylation: 20-fold molar excess sulfo-NHS-acetate;100mM sodium phosphate pH7.4/100mM NaCl;2h at room temperature; reagent removal; acetylation confirmed by MALDI-TOF according to source.
preparation_evidence.limits: No acquired SI sequences or raw MALDI spectrum; no project-authenticated completeness, sample purity or chemical occupancy.

product_confirmation.scope: Results says product formation and kinetic parameters were confirmed by HPLC; Methods says integrated substrate/product absorbance was corrected for different extinction coefficients; representative SI FigureS4 was not acquired.
product_confirmation.not_established: No independently reprocessed chromatograms or construct-specific product mass/spectral audit.

diketone_context.ligand_role: Non-turnover diketone analogue, not methodol or its observed catalytic intermediate
diketone_context.observation: Figure8 shows a distinct L105K absorbance band around360nm compared with buffer and CaM; source says CaM did not react with diketone. No numeric spectral fit or detection threshold is supplied.
diketone_context.assignment_scope: Source-proposed covalent-analogue class; exact state is unresolved because source terms differ and a spectrum alone does not map an attachment.
transfer_limits: Not a methodol microscopic-step rate or direct turnover intermediate.
Not evidence for the same response in CaMWN or Ac-CaMWN.
No exact source-numbered attachment atom or structural geometry.

calcium_context.observation: PanelA shows methodol signal accumulation with added calcium and little signal without added calcium under the EDTA-treated condition. The source reports no above-background activity without calcium; this is not a measured zero rate.
calcium_context.source_interpretation: Allosteric/conformational dependence of the calmodulin scaffold.
calcium_context.limits: The intervention changes added calcium and EDTA, and does not isolate direct metal participation in bond chemistry. No fit/rate ratio is reconstructed from the plotted traces.

ra61_relation.reference: Raymond2015 reference24 / discussion p566 cites Lassila2010 RA61
ra61_relation.question: Are the RA61 component estimates and calmodulin controls interchangeable evidence?
ra61_relation.answer: No. RA61 changes substrate or water-motif residues; calmodulin changes scaffold nucleophiles/terminal amine and calcium conditions. They offer distinct tests of design-component explanations.
ra61_relation.prevented_transfer: The reported RA61 roughly500-fold component estimate and calmodulin roughly2000-fold association interpretation are not matched scalar components, transferable rates or a common microscopic mechanism. No cross-study ratio is requested.
ra61_relation.source_locator: Raymond2015:p566 Discussion/reference24; retained Lassila2010:Table4/5 and Methods

source_conflicts.source_a: TableI title p566: pH7.5; Methods p569:25mM HEPES,pH7.5,50uM-1.5mM methodol
source_conflicts.resolution: Unresolved. Use TableI/Methods scope for table endpoints; no exact TableI-Figure5 raw-curve equivalence or source repair.

source_conflicts.source_a: Results p564 describes F92K and L105K calcium response
source_conflicts.source_b: Figure7 caption p567 identifies full-length CaM L105K(A) and C-terminal L105K(B)
source_conflicts.resolution: Only panelA full-length L105K is used for the qualitative linked control; panelB is not relabeled F92K or attached to unmutated cCaM.
Preserve all three source terms. Spectral response is compatible with the source-proposed covalent-analogue model; exact tautomer/protonation/bond order/occupancy remains unassigned.

source_conflicts.source_b: Caption explicitly describes buffer,CaM and CaM L105K only
source_conflicts.resolution: Do not use the blue trace to extend the source-assigned CaM/L105K pair or infer its exact construct preparation.

limitations: Only five selected TableI contexts are projected: CaM/cCaM controls, CaMWN, Ac-CaMWN and CaM-L105K. The F92K row and seven-mutant screen are outside this question; no design success rate is inferred.
No separately measured kcat, KM, substrate affinity, enantiomer preference, full sequence or physical preparation equivalence.
Printed errors have unknown statistic; no propagated uncertainty, statistical equivalence, microscopic coupling or isolated energetic contribution.
Source pH/buffer/range and analogue-state nomenclature conflicts remain explicit; unacquired SI cannot authenticate sequences, HPLC traces or acetylation completeness.
Positive activity does not identify a lysine mechanism; negative analogue/calcium responses are scoped observations, not exact zeros or universal inactivity.
No canonical reaction admission, frozen-kernel/protected-registry change, evidence-tier promotion, project experiment or demonstrated design performance.
